directory_hint: This path is on the Arupa host; relative paths use the Kernel's working directory. Put service packages in the new directory before saving. Saving creates the directory if needed and scans it; existing instances keep running.
directory_refresh_failed: Directory saved, but the service list could not be refreshed. Try Refresh.
defaults_hint: These values apply to every service without its own override. Empty fields use the built-in defaults: manual start, the current process user, no checksum and no group restriction.
default_checksum_hint: The default checksum is inherited by every service without its own checksum and prevents loading unpacked packages. Usually set checksums per service.
default_params_hint: These parameters are inherited by all services. A service's own value overrides the same key. Changes are used at the next start.
default_settings_saved: Service defaults saved. The list now shows the updated effective settings.
default_params_saved: Default parameters saved. Services use the new values at their next start.
page_description: Inspect installed packages and manage running services.
version_hint: Restart to load the package version currently on disk.
missing_package: The package is no longer on disk. This instance can be stopped, but cannot be started or restarted.
no_runtime: This service has no running instance. Start it to inspect registered routes and transports.
inherited_hint: Empty string fields inherit Services.default. Group access can inherit defaults, allow all groups, or restrict access to named groups.
config_hint: Saving does not start or stop the service. Restart policy applies to subsequent exits and retries; user, checksum and parameters apply on the next start.
restart_limited: Restart on failure with a limit
allow_hint: Enter group names separated by commas.
params_hint: Parameters may contain secrets. Values are only fetched when requested; they remain hidden until you choose to show them.
params_invalid: Parameter keys must be non-empty and unique.
params_saved: Parameters saved. Restart the service to use the new values.
action_refresh_failed: The action completed, but the list could not be refreshed. Try Refresh.
settings_refresh_failed: Settings saved, but the list could not be refreshed. Try Refresh.
confirm_stop: Stop {name}? Its routes will become unavailable and pending retries will be cancelled.
confirm_restart: Restart {name}? The current instance will stop and the latest disk package will be loaded.
confirm_self: This is the service manager. This page may become unavailable after the action.
self_action_done: Action completed. Reload this page after the service manager is available again.
unknown_error: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
refresh_failed: Could not refresh services. The displayed data may be out of date.
catalog_failed: Could not scan the service directory.
service_not_enabled: Service management is not enabled, or the resource is unavailable.
service_api_empty_response: Service API returned an empty response.
service_api_unsuccessful: Service API reported an unsuccessful request.
discovered_services_no_data: Discovered services response has no data.
running_services_no_data: Running services response has no data.
service_directory_no_data: Service directory response has no data.
temporary_directory_no_data: Temporary directory response has no data.
groups_required: Enter at least one group, or select No group restriction.
